name: Leaf yellowing observation
whereToLook: New and old leaves across more than one representative tree, plus the root zone and irrigation conditions.
visibility: Record whether yellowing is between veins or uniform, which leaf age is affected first, and whether the pattern occurs across the orchard.
seasonality: A locally reviewed deficiency calendar is not yet available.
identificationNotes: Leaf colour alone cannot distinguish zinc, iron, root stress, disease, salinity, or other causes.
immediateAction: Record the pattern and seek appropriate soil or leaf-test guidance before applying a nutrient product.
managementEvidence: Demonstration disorder guide: no nutrient dose is published without confirmation and source-backed crop context.
